notes.title: Rubikingdom v0.7.8(Custom Games Update)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39315536/f46564a8acc8fe7b3a431260e1cf13fa7ce731b1.png

Today we release the custom game option for Rubikingdom. You will be able to set resources, population, soldiers, prestige, event turns, and god anger. Custom games will not count towards the leaderboards.

New Features

Added Custom option to the main menu.


Changes

Added a new animation to the navigation panel to help show the direction of spin to the main face.

notes.title: Rubikingdom v0.7.3.3(Patch)
notes.notes:
We did not expect scores to get so high! So today we are putting out a minor patch to limit the size scale of the end game score on screen. 

Changes

End game score now has a proper maximum and minimum size on screen.


The next small update will be the addition of difficulty rankings added to the kingdom screen.  
These will focus on:

Food
God
War
resource 


We hope you are enjoying the game and look forward to connecting with you on our trello.
Please join us there to provide feedback and bug reports.

https://trello.com/b/G2AihwKW/rubikingdom

Many Thanks,
For/War Team

notes.title: Rubikingdom Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
Today we are announcing that Rubikingdom will release into Early Access on December 23, 2020 at a 40% discount($3.59 usd). We are excited to get the game into the hands of players and start shaping it into something that everyone can enjoy. Please join us on Trello to provide us feedback, bug reports, and ideas.

Thanks again in advance,
For/War Games Team
